title.en: Constancy read at a member's class, what the reach asks, and how what lies outside it is divided
title.zh: 于员之类之至终有常，此及所须，与类外之分

statement.en: Constancy up to the net's end at a member's class carries the path's laws; the reach needs only that the class hold the effects of the member and its line. Where the member acts, it and alike occurrences must follow each other, so the division outside bears only through its own leaving effects.
statement.zh: 于员之类之至网之终有常足承此路诸律；此及唯须类持员及其线之所缘。员有所缘时，员与同类者须相随，故类外之分唯经其己出类之效而入。

laws.en: Constancy up to the net's end asked only of the occurrences alike to a member is that condition at the member's class; constancy up to the net's end is that at every member's class.
laws.zh: 只问与一员同类者之至网之终有常，为于此员之类之至网之终有常；至网之终有常即于每一员之类皆然。
declarations: Becoming.«至终有常则本类至终有常»

laws.en: Each law of the path that asks constancy up to the net's end holds at the member's class, and PF's and PF2's forms are its corollaries: where a member conditions something and the class holds its effects, what is alike to it conditions only what is alike to it, everything downstream is on its line, and what a line reaches it carries on; holding the effects is everything downstream being alike; and what leaves the class follows every alike occurrence that conditions anything.
laws.zh: 此路诸问至网之终有常之律，皆于员之类成立，PF 与 PF2 之形为其推论：一员有所缘而类持其所缘时，与之同类者唯缘同类者，其下游皆在其线上，线所及者延至其后；持所缘即下游皆同类；出类者随每一有所缘之同类者。
declarations: Becoming.«出类不随则本类不至终有常»
Becoming.«本类常则闭当且仅当后皆同类»

laws.en: A line that ends while it still conditions something fails the condition at its class, and the condition asks more than that a line end only where the net does; the organism's class fails it at the first member in both finite witnesses, and in a witness where the class holds a member's effects but what follows them is not alike to it, the class fails it at the member.
laws.zh: 线亡而仍有所缘者，于其类不成此条件，而此条件所问多于线唯于网终处亡；两有限见证中，个体之类于首员处不成之；见证中类持一员之所缘而其后者不与之同类，此类于此员处不成之。
declarations: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»

laws.en: How what lies outside is divided bears on the condition only through what is alike to an effect that leaves the member's class. Where the member conditions something, the condition is that whatever an alike occurrence conditions is alike to something the member conditions, and whatever the member conditions, each alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something alike to it; so how what lies outside is divided bears on it only through what is alike to the member's own effects that leave the class, and is idle where the class holds the member's effects.
laws.zh: 类外之分唯经与出员之类之效同类者而系于此条件。员有所缘时，此条件即：同类者之所缘皆与员之某所缘同类，而员之每一所缘，每一有所缘之同类者皆缘与之同类者；故类外之分唯经与员己出类之效同类者系于此条件，类持员之所缘时，类外如何分无关。
declarations: Becoming.«本类常当且仅当与己相随»

laws.en: Merging what lies outside keeps the condition, so where a predicate decides the member's class the split of that class from the rest asks least; under the split the condition is that what stays and what leaves follow every alike occurrence that conditions anything, and it holds where every such occurrence conditions something in the class and something outside.
laws.zh: 合类外者不失此条件，故一谓词判员之类时，以此类与其余二分者所问最少；二分之下，此条件即留者与出者皆随每一有所缘之同类者，凡此等者皆既缘类内者又缘类外者时即成。
declarations: Becoming.«二分本类常当且仅当内外皆随»
Becoming.«内外皆缘则二分本类常»

laws.en: Dividing what lies outside more finely can break the condition, even where every alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something in the class and something outside; witnesses where the split meets it.
laws.zh: 细分类外者可破此条件，即使每一有所缘之同类者皆既缘类内者又缘类外者；见证中二分成之。

laws.en: Constancy up to the net's end can fail under the split while the member's class keeps the condition and holds the member's effects, where alike occurrences outside differ in what they condition in it; a finer division is constant up to the net's end.
laws.zh: 类外同类者于员之类中所缘不一时，二分可不至网之终有常，而员之类仍成此条件、持其所缘；更细之分则至网之终有常。

laws.en: Everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line, with no regularity assumed; so the reach needs the member's effects held, and it excludes a line from the member that ends while its last stage still conditions something, as the organism's class shows. With them, where the member conditions something, the condition at the member's class gives the reach and holds the effects of every alike occurrence; but the reach does not need it: in a witness the class holds the member's effects and everything downstream of the member lies on its line, while the class fails the condition at the member and does not hold the effects of an alike occurrence off that line.
laws.zh: 一员之后皆在其类下之线上，当且仅当其后皆与之同类，即类持员及其线上每一阶之所缘，不设有常；故此及须持员之所缘，且不容自员之线亡而其末阶犹有所缘，如有机体之类。持之，员有所缘时，员之类之至终有常足致此及，并持每一同类者之所缘；而此及不须之：见证中类持员之所缘，员之后皆在其线上，而此类于此员处不成此条件，亦不持其线外一同类者之所缘。
declarations: Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭»

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class, the split given by a decided predicate; the witnesses' nets supplied, with discrete steps and equality on their carriers.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：对一切载体、关系与类，二分由可判之谓词给出；见证之网为所给，设离散之步与载体上之相等。

does_not_show.en: That P2 should be read at one's own class, or with the split: that is argued as a reading, not proved.
does_not_show.zh: P2 应读于自之类、应取二分：此作为读法论之，非证得。

does_not_show.en: Which effects are one's own (the path's P4).
does_not_show.zh: 何效为己之效（此路之 P4）。

does_not_show.en: That every occurrence alike to an actual agent that conditions anything both conditions something in the class of its line and leaves something outside it (a correspondence).
does_not_show.zh: 实际行动者之每一有所缘之同类者，皆既缘其线之类内者又有出其类者（一对应）。

does_not_show.en: That the split is the only division worth reading: finer divisions sort effects by kind, which other questions may need.
does_not_show.zh: 二分为唯一可读之分：更细之分按种类分效，他问或需之。

does_not_show.en: That a class under which every line from a member ends only where the net does meets the condition at the member: in CleanStep it does not.
does_not_show.zh: 自一员出之线皆唯于网终处亡之类，于此员处成此条件：CleanStep 中不成。

does_not_show.en: That the class of an actual agent's line holds the effects of each stage of its line, with P2 or without it (a correspondence).
does_not_show.zh: 实际行动者之线之类，有此理或无之，皆持其线之每一阶之所缘（一对应）。

next_delta.en: Correspondences: whether actual agents meet P2 read with the split (each alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something in the class and leaves something outside), and whether the class of an agent's line holds the effects of each stage of that line, as the path needs. Whether one presupposes P2 or only that, and the crux P4, are put to philosophers (P-20, questions 6 and 2).
next_delta.zh: 二对应：实际行动者是否满足以二分读之之 P2（每一有所缘之同类者皆既缘类内者又有出类者），及行动者之线之类是否持该线每一阶之所缘，此即此路所须。所预设者为 P2 抑或仅此，及关键 P4，交哲学家（P-20 第 6、2 问）。

correspondence.en: Read with the path's P2: a self's regularity of its own is constancy up to the net's end at its own class. Of a self that acts and holds its effects it requires, however what one leaves out is divided, that every occurrence alike to it condition only what is alike to it, so its line continues from every alike occurrence that conditions anything. Of a self drawn by intention, read with the split of itself from the rest, it requires that where any alike occurrence conditions something in its class, or something outside, every alike occurrence that conditions anything does too, which holds where each both conditions something in its class and leaves something outside. The path itself asks less: that the class hold the effects of the self and of each stage of its line; given that the self holds its effects and acts, P2 gives this and also holds the effects of every occurrence alike to the self, off its line included. The reading is the AI's.
correspondence.zh: 以此路之 P2 读之：自之自有之理，即于其自之类之至网之终有常。于有所缘且持其所缘之自，无论所遗于外者如何分，要求与之同类者皆唯缘同类者，故其线于每一有所缘之同类者皆续。于以所意划之自，以自与其余二分读之，要求凡有一同类者缘类内者或缘类外者，则每一有所缘之同类者亦然；每一者皆既缘类内者又有出类者时即成。此路自身所问较少：类持自及其线之每一阶之所缘；自持其所缘且有所缘时，P2 致此，并持与自同类之每一者之所缘，其线外者亦然。读法为 AI 之。

history.en: 25 October 2026: added (OC1), answering 07 §4.6's Open item on which class P2 reads and how finely it divides what one leaves out; study section 408.

history.en: 25 October 2026: reviewed independently (OC2): 4 errors, 9 imprecisions and 4 clarity points in its texts, no proof wrong, all fixed; the laws extended (what lies outside bears only through effects leaving the class; a sufficient condition under the split; the condition asks more than line-ending; the witnesses at the member's class; FinerWake). The Open item it answered: its formal part by laws, the choice of class by a labelled reading. Study section 411.
